# TerraFusion — Vendor Conversation Package

**Audience:** commercial govtech vendors (CAMA / assessment platforms).
**Purpose:** a tight, diligence-safe package for licensing conversations at WSACA and after.
**Frame:** asset + rights + problem + proof. Not a movement, not a manifesto, not a vision deck.

---

## The one claim everything anchors to

> Benton County runtime pilot on TerraFusion DB as system-of-record, with a proof-gated
> 39-county provenance inventory as the expansion path — a disciplined single-county proof
> that scales reproducibly, not a 39-county launch.

Say this. Repeat this. Every other statement in this package must be consistent with it.

---

| File | What it's for | When to hand it over |
|---|---|---|
| [`one-pager.md`](one-pager.md) | The thing you put on the table. What it is, problem it solves, what's included, rights, why it matters. Includes the demo walkthrough. | First meeting / booth. |

## How to run a vendor conversation with this

1. **Open with the asset, not the platform.** "I'm not here with a generic pitch deck. I'm
   here with a defined assessor-modernization asset that can be licensed exclusively in your
   field." (See one-pager.)
2. **Lead with risk reduction** (Story 3), not features. Counties distrust migrations; this
   is a transition-safe, continuity-first posture. Roadmap-acceleration (Story 2) and
   stack-strengthening (Story 1) are secondary.
3. **State the field-of-use up front:** Assessor / CAMA administration. This is the first
   thing they'll pin you on — answer it before they ask.
4. **Offer the opening posture:** exclusive, perpetual, irrevocable license *within that
   field*, with sublicense + derivative + embed rights; you retain underlying IP. Mention a
   milestone-tied buyout as a later option, not the opening.
5. **Never outrun the proof.** If you can't defend a claim on the spot, downgrade it. The
   asset inventory tiers exist precisely so you don't.

---

## Do-NOT-say list (these fail diligence on contact)

- ❌ "39-county production launch" / "multi-county runtime live." It's a **Benton pilot +
  39-county provenance inventory**. Full stop.
- ❌ "Certified / official CostForge valuations." The cost calculator is post-90-day; do not
  imply certified output.
- ❌ Investor-deck numbers: 92% cycle-time cut, 400%+ ROI, $1–3B patent value, 50-county
  Year-1, agent-swarm counts, "world's first," any physics/quantum framing. Those live in
  `docs/business/` for investors — they are **not** vendor proof and must not be blended in.
- ❌ Tyler Vision as a Benton system. It isn't, and never was.
- ❌ Any capability tagged `spec-only` or `aspirational` in the asset inventory described as
  if it's running today.

---

## Out of scope for vendor conversations

The PBL / federation / "constitutional governance" framing is the **association /
stewardship lane**, not the vendor lane. Keep it out of these rooms — it raises diligence
friction and dilutes a clean commercial ask. It has its own track.
